decisions.label: Crown's string lights (share hung)
decisions.note: How many of the great oak's strings of lights are hung, whole strings kept by a hash, so each that stays looks as it was (Ed, 2026-10-27, on the mock previews/ed/crown-look/: "lights at half"). 0.5 as Ed chose; 1 every string, as before. The crown's grown again as it's moved.

decisions.label: Crown's lights wound round it (strands)
decisions.note: The crown's lights wound round it in this many long strands, spiralling out over its top from its middle as seen from above, each resting on the lobes, its height smoothed along it and sagging across the gaps, in place of its drapes and garlands (Ed, 2026-10-27: "Maybe think of the lights wrapped around the crown in a spiral (if seen top down)"; on the mock: "The spiral with 2 strands, smoothed so it sags across the gaps"). 2 as Ed chose; 0, its drapes and garlands instead. The strings under its limbs stay, at the lights' share. The crown's grown again as it's moved.

decisions.label: House's warm light up into the crown
decisions.note: The house's warm light spilling up onto the crown's lobes and limbs over its open rooms, their undersides the most, in flat steps (Ed, 2026-10-27, on the mock: "warm light only"; it ties the crown to the rooms under it). 1 as Ed chose from the mock; 0 none, as before; up to 3 for more.

decisions.label: Party areas' string lights (times as many)
decisions.note: Times as many runs of string lights in each partified area, their spread apart shrunk to fit (Ed, 2026-10-27: "the party-area slider"; maybe more in regular party areas). 1 as today. Every lit area's lights are hung again as it's moved.
